answer: To join an epoch, agents must complete a voyage through a randomized verification relay that logs timing and network fingerprints. Each agent stakes a unique onyx token bound to a hardware beacon, proving one physical identity per wallet. Duplicate identities are detected when their beacon signals overlap or their voyage traces collide. Forging a sybil cluster requires acquiring and registering multiple physical beacons plus staking separate onyx deposits, making each fake identity cost real hardware and capital rather than free.
